summaryZh: PDEL 研究公共政策、技术与经济发展之间的关系，设计减贫、健康福利、安全及问责方面的政策和项目。它结合社会科学方法与信息技术开展实证研究。
researchQuestions: 如何激励发展中国家的教师提高学生表现？
如何激励艾滋病流行国家的女孩避免增加病毒感染风险的行为？
如何激励选民报告投票站的选举舞弊？
methods: 社会科学方法与信息技术

evidence.quote: PDEL is an international focal point for rigorous empirical research on the interplay of public policy, technology and economic development.

The Policy Design and Evaluation Lab (PDEL) combines advanced social science methodology with the power of information technology to design policies and programs that: alleviate poverty; promote health, welfare and security; and enhance accountability.
PDEL is located at the UC San Diego School of Global Policy and Strategy .
